parts.text:
To sign in to your Microsoft account, you can use one of the following official links depending on what you want to access:

*   **To manage your Microsoft Account (profile, security, billing, subscriptions):**
    👉 [**account.microsoft.com**](https://account.microsoft.com/)

*   **To check your Outlook, Hotmail, or Live email:**
    👉 [**outlook.live.com**](https://outlook.live.com/)

*   **To access Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive for work or school):**
    👉 [**login.microsoftonline.com**](https://login.microsoftonline.com/)

---

### 🔒 Security Tips for Logging In:
1. **Check the URL:** Before entering your password, always make sure the address bar in your browser starts with `https://login.live.com/` or `https://account.microsoft.com/` and shows a secure lock icon.
2. **Enable Two-Step Verification:** To keep your account secure, go to your account security settings and turn on **Two-Step Verification (2FA)**. You can also download the **Microsoft Authenticator** app on your phone for passwordless sign-in.
